raw_html: [[Named item sets#One with the Swarm|One with the Swarm]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Named item sets#One with the Swarm|One with the Swarm]]:''' While wearing two pieces from the One with the Swarm set, you gain: You are protected by a swarm of hostile bees that lash out when you are struck in melee range. On vorpal melee strikes, they will also swarm your enemies, dealing Piercing damage over time.
